description: baseBranchPatterns: updates is the working branch of this fork; master mirrors microsoft/winget-pkgs.
ignoreDeps: ubuntu runners must stay on the oldest supported version.

gitIgnoredAuthors: biome-migrate.yaml commits the migrated biome.jsonc to a Renovate branch as github-actions[bot]; without this, Renovate takes that commit for a manual edit, marks the pull request as edited and stops updating it.

packageRules.description: The tools in .tool-versions carry Renovate hints of their own, handled by the custom manager below.

customManagers.description: Renovate hints after a comment: `# datasource=<datasource> depName=<depName>`. A trailing ! of a version pinned in .trunk/trunk.yaml is left out of the version.
